findings_qualitative.value: Elongated ~20 kpc [CII] and continuum structure west of the QSO interpreted as a tidally stretched interacting companion; PV diagram suggests merger bridge or early disc settling, unresolved.

evidence.quote: it is likely tracing a star-forming companion, extending on scales of $\sim$4 arcsec, in other words $\sim$20 kpc, that is interacting with the QSO host galaxy.

claims.hypothesis: Is there an interacting companion to J0100+2802?
claims.experiment: Channel maps, [CII] and continuum maps in bands 3 and 6 with PSF subtraction
claims.result: Co-spatial elongated [CII] and band 6 continuum emission ~4 arcsec west; band 3 detection 0.007 mJy

evidence.quote: This supports the scenario in which the extended \[CII\] emission is associated with an interacting system and not an outflowing or jetted component.

claims.experiment: Two-Gaussian fit to spectrum and high-velocity map
claims.result: Broad blue component FWHM 635 km/s, Mdot 118-269 Msun/yr
claims.finding: Cold outflow with low momentum load, likely jet-aligned

evidence.quote: We interpret such a broad \[CII\] wing as an indication of a cold outflow

claims.hypothesis: Does the outflow efficiently remove gas?
claims.finding: Outflow cannot be very effective at removing gas

evidence.quote: we conclude that the outflow cannot be very effecting at removing the gas from the galaxy.

why_this_data.value: High sensitivity low-resolution data recover extended, diffuse emission missed by higher-resolution observations

evidence.quote: reinforcing the idea that $\sim 1$ arcsec-resolution observations with a high sensitivity are ideal to probe the more extended and diffuse emission

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Broad wing as inflow or fainter companion judged unlikely given jet alignment and high dispersion

evidence.quote: Alternative interpretations of the broad wing are that it could be inflowing gas or a fainter companion.

limitations_admitted.value: Resolution cannot distinguish merging from rotation, or single from multiple companions

evidence.quote: However, the resolution of our observation did not allow us to distinguish between merging and rotation processes.

referee_caveats_inferred: Companion dust SED has only two detections and fixed Tdust, so degenerate
Outflow gas mass depends on unspecified PDR parameters
Broad component could partly be QSO host/companion kinematics
Flux and PSF-subtraction depend on region choices
